title: 工具调用期间崩溃会留下什么
label: FIG. 7.2
caption: 只有两份记录都认定重复执行安全时，工具才会运行两次。崩溃前存储的意图和崩溃后注册的工具都必须声明 `replay: "safe"`；`replay` 默认为 `"unsafe"`，见 `durable/src/harness/types.ts:215`。第4行记录的是失败结果，因此该调用拥有的对话会被中止。来源：`ToolTask.execute`，`durable/src/harness/tool.ts:94`。

committed
nodes.detail: checkpoint { phase: "execute", arguments, replay }

nodes.detail: running tasks show as pending until they run again

nodes.label:
3 · both say safe
rerun
nodes.detail: stored intent and current registration both have replay: "safe"; clear progress, run again

failed
nodes.detail: settle as interrupted: "Tool X was interrupted and may have partially run"
